channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Saudis make deal with Japan to replenish depleted oil stockpiles
item.description: The accord is further evidence of how major producers and consumers are taking steps to boost their energy security amid the U.S.-Iran war.

item.title: Takaichi meets with leaders of Chile and Peru in bid to boost ties
item.description: Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori and Chilean President Jose Antonio Kast held their first bilateral summits with Tokyo on Friday.

item.title: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries to take on launch operations for Japan’s H3 rocket
item.description: Transfer of the operations from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency will take part in stages and begin with the next launch.

item.title: From ukiyo-e to ‘Godzilla,’ where do Japanese monsters stand in the Asian imagination?
item.description: "Myths and Monsters: The Art of Fantasy in Asia" exhibits some 430 works, surveying two centuries of Asian storytelling, with a heavy focus on Japan.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
